integrity: Complete derivation and a standalone independent sitewise CTMC diagnostic; finite Monte Carlo tests do not certify an infinite theorem or priority.
scientific_limitations: Infinite nearest-neighbor line, no forgetting, one initially infected site, homogeneous transmission lambda>0 and unit stifling. Last new infection is not extinction time; no other geometries or mechanisms covered.
title: Exact last-transmission law and a nonmonotone transmission-rate optimum in a spatial rumor
